canonical_method: Recursive Scientific Reconstruction + Library Consolidation / Orbit provenance-retrieval-admission discipline
relation_policy: Relations retrieve and organize candidates; relation or similarity alone never transfers evidence, identity, truth, or authority.
admission_policy: Import method/navigation support by default. Promote evidence or conclusions only after receiver-local verification against an explicit obligation, baseline, claim ceiling, and improvement witness.
authority_policy: Each source/project remains authoritative only for what its own current evidence and declared boundary support; historical/source-native records are never rewritten to fit the overlay.
recovery_policy: Preserve source identity, predecessors, failures/nulls/invalids, unresolved remainder, and stable recovery handles; add successor/supersession edges instead of destructive replacement.
notes: This binding is metadata/method support, not a scientific result and not a runtime authority transfer.
Private Library contents and paths are not exported by this public binding.
